beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste this: my agent marks features done by running the tests and writing a result file — but it sometimes marks done without proof. Show me how to write a PreToolUse hook that intercepts the file write, checks whether the test results actually exist and are green, and blocks the write if they don't.
